title: Korea Packing List: What to Bring in Every Season
summary: Packing for Korea depends on the season. Here’s what to bring for summer, winter, spring and autumn, plus the plug adapter you’ll need.

slides.title: Pack For Each Season
slides.voice: Korea packing? Every season needs different gear. Pack by season.

slides.title: Stay Cool And Dry
slides.voice: Summer: quick-dry clothes, a compact umbrella, and shoes that handle puddles.
slides.photo_query: Korea summer travel umbrella quick-drying clothes shoes

slides.title: Layer Up For Cold
slides.sub: Long coat, thermal layer, hat, scarf, gloves
slides.voice: Winter: a long padded coat, thermal layer, hat, scarf and gloves.
slides.photo_query: Korea winter padded coat thermal clothing hat scarf gloves

slides.title: Dress For Both Ends
slides.sub: T-shirt, jumper, light jacket; warmer coat
slides.voice: Spring and autumn: T-shirt, jumper, light jacket. Add a warmer coat for early March or November.
slides.photo_query: Korea spring autumn layered clothing light jacket

slides.title: Bring The Right Adapter
slides.sub: Type C or F adapter; 220 volts
slides.voice: Bring a Type C or F adapter. Korea uses two hundred twenty volts; check appliance labels.
slides.photo_query: Korea Type C Type F plug adapter

slides.title: New Korea tips
slides.voice: Subscribe for more Korea tips every Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday.
